detailed_description: This free online XML Sitemap Generator creates a simple sitemap.xml file from the URLs you enter in the browser. Start with a base URL, edit the starter rows or add your own paths, set each page's loc, lastmod, changefreq, and priority values, then generate well-formed sitemap XML that can be copied or downloaded as sitemap.xml. It is useful when you need a small hand-maintained sitemap, a quick XML sample for a project, or a clean starting point before adding URLs to a CMS or build pipeline. The tool does not crawl a live website, fetch pages automatically, validate ownership, submit URLs to search engines, or split large sitemap indexes; it only formats the URL list you provide.
usage_steps: Enter the base URL, including the protocol, such as https://example.com.
Edit the starter paths or add more URL rows for the pages you want in the XML sitemap.
Choose a last modified date, change frequency, and priority for each row.
Click Generate Sitemap to build the XML output.
Review the XML, then copy it or download sitemap.xml.
usage_examples: Create a compact sitemap.xml file for a five-page brochure site before uploading it to the site root.
Draft sitemap XML for a staging project where the final build process is not ready yet.
Prepare a manual list of priority landing pages for a client review or SEO handoff.

faqs.question: Does the Sitemap Generator crawl my website?
faqs.answer: No. It is a manual XML sitemap builder. Enter the URLs or paths you want included, then the page formats those rows into sitemap XML.

faqs.question: Which sitemap fields can I set?
faqs.answer: Each URL row includes loc, lastmod, changefreq, and priority values. These are common XML sitemap fields used to describe the URL and update hint.

faqs.question: Can I download sitemap.xml?
faqs.answer: Yes. After generating the XML, you can copy the text or download it as sitemap.xml from the browser.

faqs.question: Is this for large sites?
faqs.answer: It is best for small manual sitemaps and drafts. It does not crawl thousands of pages, create sitemap indexes, or split large sitemap files automatically.
